content:
Almost 9 professors from IIT/IIM have blocked me here on LinkedIn when I caught them doing casteism. I didn't record them, as I already know that these things will change this year and beyond.

Ideally, if the upper caste had good intentions, then these changes would have happened in 1990, but now it is happening in 2024. Post-2026, it is now fully mainstream.

The upper caste will engage in fear-mongering, but they will fail eventually, just like we saw with the “Reservation Hatao Andolan.”

The days of Brahminical dominance are almost finished, especially post-CJP protests.
comment: Institutional change is often measured not only by policies but by whether people feel safe reporting bias and whether accountability systems work consistently across organizations.
